capital_cost_usd.basis: NREL ATB 2024 regional capex estimates scaled to Mountain West study area; IRA/BIL federal funding projections
capital_cost_usd.note: Order-of-magnitude estimates; actual spending depends on policy, market conditions, and private investment

labor_years.basis: ACP Clean Energy Employment Impacts 2023; IMPLAN Mountain West multiplier v3.2; BLS QCEW energy sector employment
labor_years.note: Person-years available for energy transition work in study area; includes construction and O&M workforce

steel_tons.basis: NREL TP-5000-73853 (wind), TP-6A20-73436 (solar), NETL Vol.1 (thermal); aggregated by era deployment targets
steel_tons.note: Derived from per-action material coefficients in action_library_v3.json scaled to projected era deployment

concrete_tons.basis: Same sources as steel_tons; concrete-intensive actions include wind foundations, nuclear containment, transmission
concrete_tons.note: Concrete supply assumed unconstrained in Mountain West; constraint is labor and transport, not material

HALEU_kg.basis: Centrus Piketon OH cascade 900 kg/yr initial production (DOE press release 2023-12-13); BWXT Gillette increment at 2029
HALEU_kg.source: Centrus Piketon 900 kg/yr x era years; BWXT increment at 2029
HALEU_kg.note: Foundation era: 900 kg/yr x 10 yr = 9,000 kg. Transition era: +BWXT if operational. Later eras assume scale-up.

transmission_row_miles.basis: WECC Transmission Plan 2023; Wyoming Infrastructure Authority corridor studies
transmission_row_miles.note: Right-of-way miles permitted per era; actual construction depends on NEPA, state permitting timelines
